scope: Local installed executable; owned PTY output, not physical terminal presentation. No application changes or builds. One startup and 20 repetitions of zoom in/out and right/left per primary scenario, at document-fit zoom. Samples are sequential in the same process with at least 30 ms between completed operations. Different scenes also have different fit zoom/content, so their ratio is not an isolated node-count scaling benchmark. Kitty/ZLIB is explicit (TERM=xterm-kitty); native Herdr/WezTerm display time and automatic protocol negotiation are excluded. OS caches, machine load and CPU frequency are uncontrolled.

harness.notes: Ad hoc Python standard-library forkpty observer. Kitty RGBA is decoded, decompressed and hashed. Frame receipt timestamps precede final-chunk parsing; sync timestamps include observer parsing/backpressure. Adapter is /usr/bin/false, so no prompt or provider/account request is sent. Font fallback config matches the prior local preview check. Normal macOS font access was required; sandbox trials failed with Inter unavailable and are excluded.
